body:
I dont have too much expierience with drugs. I've done weed, mushrooms, and lsa. And I've done wild dagga at least 25 times. I personally really enjoy it. The setting is in my bedroom alone listening to music.
So I have a large amount of dagga. And more coming in the mail. I decide today is the day I'm really going to go for it. I take out a very large tobacco pipe. And proceed to smoke three bowls. I didnt like the taste when I first started but it grew on me and now I love it. For some the smoke is a little harsh but definatly tolerable.
After that I layed down on my bed listening to bob marley-legend. It was amazing how in depth the music sounded. It seemed like whatever I felt the mood of the song was my emotions changed to that. Very euphoric. When I opened my eyes my vision was fogged like when I do some weed. I didnt pay attention to the time but if I had to guess I'd say it lasted about 2 hours.
A small to medium grade weed high. Also it might be a factor that I always get the klip dagga. I would like to try this with blue lotus and damiana. But for now I'm happy with just this. I will continue to use this just about everyday. Yeah I like it that much. Not that its addictive (although some people suggest it is very mildly addictive) also interesting combined with weed.
